main_body: market stall with awning and counter
top_band: olive green sloped awning from row 2 to 12, plus counter top around rows 25-28
evidence: Has the exact same 3/4 geometry as the Beodeul cheese stall reference: a large sloped awning (rows 2-12) casting a scalloped shadow (rows 11-14) over the recessed back display and counter front below (rows 14-41).

style.evidence: This is a posterized, color-reduced degradation of the Beodeul cheese stall reference: the striped textured awning is replaced by a giant flat single-color olive rectangle (rows 2-10), the wood counter front (rows 29-40) is a solid unshaded brown fill with all grain and door lines stripped out, and the whole sprite uses only 4 colors total with thick black/near-black outlines.
